integrated_multimodal_description:
This is a standard vertical 9:16 portrait video. The sky must be at the very top of the frame, the ground and crowds at the very bottom. The frame is NOT rotated — the horizon stays perfectly level and horizontal, gravity points straight down, and the camera is held upright, never tilted sideways. Absolutely forbidden: horizontal composition, any 90-degree rotation of the frame, sideways or tilted ground, a tilted horizon, the sky appearing at the side of the frame, or vertical pillars rendered lying horizontally.
[Shot 1] Chinese celestial palace, ethereal xianxia realm in the heavenly court, vast architecture dwarfing tiny human figures, when the shot centers on a figure: medium or close shot of a fictional xianxia character in flowing robes, colossal architecture and mist still towering behind, three-tier spatial layers: foreground columns/archways framing, middle sea of clouds, background grand palace silhouette at horizon, strict central-axis symmetry, one-point perspective vanishing to infinity, at least one floating structure (sky bridge, cloud terrace, floating island), cold blue-gray low-saturation environment, moon white and ice blue tones, high-saturation warm accents only on character costumes (vermilion, emerald, gold), diffused soft light with ethereal mist, no harsh shadows, descending sacred light beams, subtle rim light on flowing robes, deep blue night sky with cold moonlight, misty atmospheric depth. 

The scene unfolds on the second tier of the Cloud Spirit Fields, a colossal terraced platform suspended in a sea of low-saturation white mist. The camera executes a slow vertical tilt with small amplitude at slow speed, rising from a low angle close to the ground. Initially, the frame is filled with the intricate details of heavy, golden rice ears and silver-tipped highland barley, their plant fibers rendered with realistic roughness and semi-translucent shell gloss. Cold blue ambient light dominates the environment, while warm golden side-backlighting precisely strikes the crops, creating a high-contrast cold-warm separation and a Tyndall effect of dust particles in the air. As the camera ascends, it reveals the middle ground where bronze wood-ox puppets, exhibiting a cold, oxidized metal texture and ancient mechanical joints, bow their heads to harvest the stalks. Beside them, a spiritual farmer in muted robes sweeps a sleeve, sending a shower of golden grains into the air like rain. The shallow depth of field keeps the foreground rice ears softly blurred to guide the eye, while the background cloud sea remains in soft bokeh. The camera continues its steady rise, bringing a floating fruit pavilion into view, where glowing vermilion apples and purple crystal grapes hang in clusters, their warm light contrasting with the icy blue mist. Finally, the frame settles on a medium close-up of an Immortal in a vermilion robe, standing on a stone ridge. The heavy silk of their wide sleeves shows a thick, draping texture with subtle dust reflections. The Immortal’s face is serene, lips completely closed, eyes gazing toward the southern horizon. A trail of spiritual light, resembling tiny lanterns, ignites sequentially along the rice spikes, pointing southward. The composition remains strictly upright, with the sky at the top and the cloud terrace at the bottom, maintaining a vertical depth of field. No person appears in this shot other than the described fictional characters. The visuals play as off-screen voiceover narration while lips remain completely closed. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

overall_soundscape:
A serene and ethereal ambient soundscape. The primary texture is the soft, rustling whisper of wind moving through vast fields of rice and barley, a gentle natural hiss. Underneath, a low, resonant hum of mystical energy vibrates subtly, accompanied by the occasional soft chime of magical grains colliding. The sound is crisp and airy, with a sense of high altitude and cold air, avoiding any harsh mechanical noises. The atmosphere is calm, majestic, and deeply tranquil, evoking a sense of ancient peace and abundant harvest.
